intro: I am Executive Director of the Research and Statistics Department at the Czech National Bank. I lead the Bank's research and statistical functions, set their strategic priorities, and oversee the development of new analytical and forecasting tools that support evidence-based policymaking and the Bank's forecasting framework.

I have more than a decade of experience in financial stability, macro-financial linkages, and monetary–macroprudential policy interactions. My research focuses on monetary and macroprudential policy, banking and financial stability, including how central bank policies affect credit and households and how climate and geopolitical risks transmit through the financial system.

I remain an active researcher and publish in peer-reviewed journals including the International Journal of Central Banking and the Journal of Financial Stability. Since June 2026, I have served as Managing Editor of the Czech Journal of Economics and Finance; in my previous CNB research-management role, I also edited the CNB Working Paper and Research and Policy Note series.

I am affiliated with the Faculty of Social Sciences at Charles University and the Faculty of Finance and Accounting at the Prague University of Economics and Business, where I teach and supervise research projects.
